title: Hinomori Shiho — Unchanging Feelings〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shiho's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Now that we've decided to accept that FizzYum Cider offer, I should take another look at their commercials.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's see... What am I gonna get if I search for “FizzYum Cider” and “commercials”...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, here we go...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Wait, huh?
The results include commercials for other cider brands.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, this one has a lot of views.
I think I'll watch it...

rows.Speaker: Idol
rows.Line: <Hey, what's up...?>

rows.Speaker: Idol
rows.Line: <Hehe. You can stare all you want, but I'm not about to give you a kiss. Read. My. Lips♪>

rows.Speaker: Idol
rows.Line: <But I'd be willing to share some of this with you. Here! Have a bottle of Pure Love Cider!>

rows.Speaker: Idol
rows.Line:
<It's like a sweet and fizzy kiss!
Enjoy the taste of Pure Love Cider♪>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now I'm really glad we were asked to do one for FizzYum Cider...
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha!
You saw the cider commercial with that idol?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She's so good at acting that she can send a jolt through your heart just by looking at you♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? I didn't feel that jolt...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, I had a feeling that Pure Love Cider would be way different from FizzYum Cider just based on its name.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup♪
The theme of Pure Love Cider is “My First Love”.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But the FizzYum Cider commercial I saw after that was way too corny. It made my eyes hurt.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You mean the one that's been airing on TV? The story about the girl in the brass band and the boy on the baseball team?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, it wasn't about love or anything.
It was more about doing your best for club activities and stuff, which was fine and all...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wasn't it amazing?! They both knew how hard they were trying and were there to cheer each other up whenever things got tough.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: At the end, all their practice paid off during the game with the boy shining on the field and the girl playing her best from the stands. It was such a great expression of youth♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, you do really like those kinds of stories.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But youth, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The theme for their next commercial is “This Moment With You!”

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: The idea is to capture the smooth and refreshing taste of their beverages via students enjoying their youth.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: And Leo/need apparently checks all the boxes in terms of who they want to appear in it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The commercial I saw felt a little corny, but I feel more comfortable with the theme we were given.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, morning, Tamiya.

rows.Speaker: Tamiya
rows.Line:
...!
*Nod*
M-Morning, Hinomori!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Morning, Tamiya!
Congratulations on succeeding again today♪

rows.Speaker: Tamiya
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Morning, Tenma!
I think today's going to be another fun day!
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, Saki, why'd you congratulate her just now...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
Because she got you to say her name, Shiho♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She's been a huge fan of yours ever since she saw us play during the school festival.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: She's even come to see a bunch of our shows♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... Now that you mention it, I do remember seeing her...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If she saw us play during the school festival, then that makes her one of our oldest fans. She could've just told me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Talking to your hero isn't as easy as you make it out to be.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You should've seen her initially. She basically swooned every time she walked past your desk.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I'm not an idol or anything like Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You just don't get it!
She's your fan, which means she sees you as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's where I come in. She was wondering how she could get you to remember her name.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Which is why you congratulated her just now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup♪ You don't go up to talk to our classmates all that much, so having her greet you seemed like the best option♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, the goal is to have her talk to you more and more until she's ready to invite you to have lunch!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Don't you think it's a great expression of her youth?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, if she invites me to have lunch with her, I'll go...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Honestly...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (All this youth talk really isn't my thing.)
